title: [5/6/2024] Population in Australia according to different nationalities and areas

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The pie chart illustrates the breakdown of the Australian population based on various nationalities, whereas the table shows what percentages of residents live in urban and rural areas.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, Australian nationals are the predominant group in the entire country. In addition, the vast majority of the population gravitates towards city life regardless of their nationalities, with nearly the entire Chinese immigrant community residing in urban areas.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: According to the pie chart, nearly three quarters (73%) of the population identify as Australian, which is more than ten times higher than the figure for British people, at 7%. Meanwhile, New Zealanders, Chinese, and Dutch nationals are demographic minorities, with their respective figures being 3%,2% and 1%, and all other nationalities constitute 14%.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Regarding the locations of these communities, almost all Chinese people reside in the city, specifically 99%. Similarly, the majority of people from the UK and New Zealand live in an urban area, at 89% and 90% respectively. Finally, 83% of people originating from the Netherlands have settled and remained in the city, which is only 3% higher than that of native Australians.
